defective_pattern: Substituting manifest composite sum scores for latent variables in SEM without measurement models.
why_defective: Omission of measurement error, violation of SEM definition, conflating path analysis with SEM.
observed_symptoms: No latent variable definition (=~) in lavaan syntax.
Only regressions (~) specified among composite variables.
corrective_remedy: Enforce latent variable specification (=~) using subscales or item parcels in R lavaan.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Absence of '=~' operator in lavaan syntax when 'sem' function is called.
